collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A false rumor about a villager is spreading: trace it to its source, or let the villager speak for themselves.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A rumor is going around that (subject) has been stealing fruit from the village trees at night. It is not true. (subject) is miserable. (friend) thinks (friend.he/she) knows who started it: (third), who has been sour with (subject) since a quarrel last month. What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) asks around, carefully, and every trail leads back to (third). (friend) talks to (third) privately. (third) admits it, ashamed, and goes around the village unsaying it. It does not undo everything. But it helps.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) encourages (subject) to speak at the gathering. (subject) says plainly that the rumor is false and that it hurt. The village believes (subject.him/her). (third) sits very still and says nothing. Nobody else knows who started it. (third) does.
